reason: I've never heard of FLUGIA and I'm not handing my customer emails and CRM to an AI from a company that might not exist in two years. 'GDPR-compliant' on a landing page isn't proof, and one wrong answer from an AI support agent to a client costs me more than 99 € a month.
objection: Who is FLUGIA, where is my data stored, and what happens when the AI says something wrong to a customer in my name? I need to see it approve-before-send, not run on its own 24/7.
would_change_my_mind: A demo where I see every message waits for my approval before it goes out, plus a signed DPA with EU hosting and a couple of Belgian or French small businesses I can actually call as references.
